crossRefs.note: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.
They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?
translations.bsb: They had not gone far from the city when Joseph told his steward, “Pursue the men at once, and when you overtake them, ask, ‘Why have you repaid good with evil?
translations.kjv: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
translations.asv: And when they were gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
